overall_summary: The 'self respect' topic consistently drives higher views (ranging from 25 to 40 views) compared to topics like 'रात के ख्याल' or 'एकतरफा प्यार' which underperformed in this sample set. Hooks involving modern smartphone communication habits (chats, status lists, pinned messages) resonate best.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (40 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर' (38 views) performed significantly higher than general late-night thoughts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on modern boundary-setting narratives related to phones, chats, and self-worth.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल' (5 views) and 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) received very low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic late-night melancholy without a concrete, relatable digital or physical action hook.
